quarterly_data.quarter: NetApp press release: NetApp to Expand Partnership with SAP to Support SAP Cloud (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NetApp announced its intent to expand its long-standing partnership with SAP, with plans to explore deeper cloud-native integration of NetApp capabilities into SAP Cloud Infrastructure, SAP's Infrastructure-as-a-Service platform. Per the release, the NetApp Platform already supports key elements of the SAP Cloud Infrastructure storage architecture, delivering file and block storage services plus data protection and replication for SAP's global availability model. NetApp also plans to explore joint go-to-market initiatives with SAP, and the two plan to evaluate NetApp Object storage in SAP Cloud Infrastructure, including a technical validation. Plans only; NetApp states such statements are not a commitment.
